title: Three Boys Fishing by Lake, 1950s Snapshot Black White USA
description: A candid black-and-white square snapshot from the late 1950s depicting three young boys sitting at the edge of a pond or lake, patiently fishing with simple rods. They are wearing classic period attire including canvas high-top sneakers, jeans, and casual shirts. In the background, calm waters reflect nearby trees and small rowboats, capturing a timeless scene of mid-century American childhood leisure.
